# Emmet's Place

> Emmet's Place is a series of live jazz streams hosted by pianist Emmet Cohen. Each episode page has the full video, date, location, lineup and setlist; each musician page lists every episode they appear in.

Sitemap: https://emmetsplace.com/sitemap.xml
